usage: 炒牛肉 is commonly used as a noun referring to a dish made with stir-fried beef.
You can mention 炒牛肉 when ordering food or talking about meals.
It can be combined with adjectives to describe the dish, such as 好味嘅炒牛肉 (delicious stir-fried beef).
When asking questions or making requests, you can say 有冇炒牛肉？ (Do you have stir-fried beef?).
